neighbours.label: the word-final piece 'ay'/'AY' split off a word (ST|AY, astr|ay)
fire: The children were told not to wander astray in the woods.
THE COLOUR MANAGED TO STAY FOR A WHOLE MONTH!
WE WILL STAY HOME IF IT RAINS TOMORROW.
Our holiday STAY package includes breakfast and parking.
False prophets lead the faithful astray, the sermon warned.
Thoughts drift astray when you are tired, so take a break.
PLEASE STAY BEHIND THE YELLOW LINE AT ALL TIMES.
Hotel guests may STAY until noon on Sunday.
quiet: The children were told not to wander off in the woods.
THE COLOUR MANAGED TO LAST FOR A WHOLE MONTH!
WE WILL REMAIN HOME IF IT RAINS TOMORROW.
Our holiday HOTEL package includes breakfast and parking.
False prophets mislead the faithful, the sermon warned.
Thoughts drift away when you are tired, so take a break.
PLEASE KEEP BEHIND THE YELLOW LINE AT ALL TIMES.
Hotel guests may REMAIN until noon on Sunday.
